items.summary: Responsible for Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan retail research, covering sampling design, quality control, and population estimation. Built an NLP-enabled address matching system for Hong Kong that improved identification accuracy and reduced manual operations.

Owned methodology and core algorithms for digital advertisement rating products, partnering with engineering to ship iterations. Cut R-based factor computation from 40 minutes to under 10 seconds, and lifted age-prediction accuracy from 67% to 91% with XGBoost.

Directed Dewu’s end-to-end market analysis system—from insight mining to dashboard delivery—and launched real-time market monitoring. Built a Python analytics stack that reduced manual reporting by over 90%, and embedded LLMs to upgrade automotive after-sales category recognition.
Leading data science work at NielsenIQ, applying market analytics and AI-enabled insight delivery across measurement products.
